request.style: English, classic pop ballad, warm expressive male baritone, intimate crooner, solo acoustic grand piano accompaniment, slow and tender, C major, 70 BPM, no drums, no choir
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
She may be the face I can't forget a trace of pleasure or regret may be my treasure or the price I have to pay She may be the song that summer sings may be the chill that autumn brings may be a hundred different things within the measure of a day

[Verse]
She may be the beauty or the beast may be the famine or the feast may turn each day into a heaven or a hell she may be the mirror of my dream a smile reflected in a stream she may not be what she may seem inside her shell

[Bridge]
She who always seems so happy in a crowd whose eyes can be so private and so proud noone's allowed to see them when they cry She may be the love that cannot hope to last may come to me from shadows of the past that I remember till the day I die

[Verse]
She may be the reason I survive the why and wherefore I'm alive The one I'll care for through the rough and ready years me I'll take her laughter and her tears and make them all my souvenirs for where she goes I've got to

[Outro]
be the meaning of my life is she she mm she.
